title: Follow-up: the profile's command-surface line still says exit 0/1/2/3
description: Found by the round-1 review of opum-ai/glyph-cli#38 (answer f). CLAUDE.md:96 (the hand-written repository profile, 'What other repositories read from here') says the command surface carries 'exit codes in src/errors.ts -- stdout carries one success envelope, stderr the failure, exit 0/1/2/3'. That has been stale since GCLI-9 (slice 1, ADR 0002) landed the full frozen family: 0 ok, 1 uncaught, 2 usage, 3 not_found, 4 denied, 5 conflict, 6 validation and drift (shared by design), 7 indeterminate. The README and ADR 0002 document the full family; only this profile sentence lags. Not a behavioural defect and not part of #38. Proposed remedy: one line in the same bullet, naming the full family or deferring to ADR 0002/README instead of restating a subset, with no other profile edits. Off the plan.
plan: Correct the command-surface bullet in CLAUDE.md so it states the full exit-code family (0 ok, 1 uncaught, 2 usage, 3 not_found, 4 denied, 5 conflict, 6 validation/drift, 7 indeterminate), deferring to ADR 0002 and the README rather than restating a subset.
Leave every other hand-written line of the profile untouched.
Fold in the owed GCLI-20 correction as an additive note: the handoff note says GCLI-16 is Done, but it is To Do.
Run lore check and the PR gates (Docs, Tracker integrity, Check) green on the PR head.
